text:
```artifact
participant Patient
participant Chemist
participant Lab
participant HospitalWebsite
participant EmailService

Patient -> HospitalWebsite: Access website via URL
HospitalWebsite -> Patient: Display login page
Patient -> HospitalWebsite: Enter username and password
HospitalWebsite -> Patient: Authenticate user (positive/negative)
alt Authentication successful
    Patient -> HospitalWebsite: Select "Consultation"
    HospitalWebsite -> Chemist: Request consultation
    Chemist -> HospitalWebsite: Provide consultation details
    HospitalWebsite -> Patient: Display consultation details
    Patient -> HospitalWebsite: Enter symptoms
    HospitalWebsite -> Chemist: Submit symptoms
    Chemist -> HospitalWebsite: Provide diagnosis
    HospitalWebsite -> Patient: Display diagnosis
    Patient -> HospitalWebsite: Confirm diagnosis
    alt Confirmation received
        HospitalWebsite -> Lab: Request lab test
        Lab -> HospitalWebsite: Provide test results
        HospitalWebsite -> Patient: Display test results
        Patient -> HospitalWebsite: Confirm results
        alt Confirmation received
            HospitalWebsite -> Chemist: Generate prescription
            Chemist -> HospitalWebsite: Provide prescription
            HospitalWebsite -> Patient: Display prescription
            Patient -> HospitalWebsite: Confirm prescription
            alt Confirmation received
                HospitalWebsite -> EmailService: Send prescription via email
                EmailService -> HospitalWebsite: Email sent
                HospitalWebsite -> Patient: Display email confirmation
            else Confirmation denied
                HospitalWebsite -> Patient: Display confirmation denied message
        else Confirmation denied
            HospitalWebsite -> Patient: Display confirmation denied message
    else Confirmation denied
        HospitalWebsite -> Patient: Display confirmation denied message
else Authentication failed
    HospitalWebsite -> Patient: Display authentication failed message

alt Encrypted connection
    Patient -> HospitalWebsite: Connect via https
    HospitalWebsite -> Patient: Confirm secure connection
else Non-encrypted connection
    Patient -> HospitalWebsite: Connect via http
    HospitalWebsite -> Patient: Display security warning
```
